datasets.name: 488d3fc6
queryLines:
SELECT
  regexp_extract(code, '^(_?[^_]+)_', 1) AS project_code,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM gold_prd.hl_cs_objecten.meetlocatie
WHERE ingevoerd_datum_utc > '2022-12-31T23:59:59.000Z'
  AND compartiment_naam = 'Grondwater'
  AND meetreeks_actief = 'Ja'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY count DESC

datasets.name: 20ea33a5
queryLines:

  CASE 
    WHEN code LIKE '\\_%' THEN 'Wiertsema'
    ELSE 'Fugro'
  END AS supplier,
  COUNT(*) AS count
FROM gold_prd.hl_cs_objecten.meetlocatie
WHERE ingevoerd_datum_utc > TIMESTAMP '2022-12-31 23:59:59'
  AND compartiment_naam = 'Grondwater'
  AND meetreeks_actief = 'Ja'
GROUP BY supplier
ORDER BY count DESC

datasets.name: eb755266
queryLines:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    m.meetreeks_id,
    DATE(m.tijdstempel_utc) AS d,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.meting m
  WHERE m.tijdstempel_utc >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 14)
    AND m.tijdstempel_utc <  CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY m.meetreeks_id, DATE(m.tijdstempel_utc)
),
series AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      r.id AS meetreeks_id,
      CONCAT(o.code, '_', r.code) AS object_meetreeks_code
    FROM gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.meetreeks r
    LEFT JOIN gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.object o
      ON o.id = r.object_id
    WHERE r.bronsysteem = 'Fugro'
  )
  WHERE UPPER(object_meetreeks_code) NOT LIKE '%HANDWAARNEMING%'
),
calendar AS (
  SELECT explode(
    sequence(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 14), DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1), interval 1 day)
  ) AS d
)
SELECT
  s.meetreeks_id,
  s.object_meetreeks_code,
  CONCAT('-', CAST(DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, c.d) AS STRING), 'd') AS day_bucket, -- -14d .. -1d
  COALESCE(d.cnt, 0) AS cnt
FROM series s
CROSS JOIN calendar c
LEFT JOIN daily d
  ON d.meetreeks_id = s.meetreeks_id
 AND d.d = c.d
ORDER BY
  s.meetreeks_id,
  c.d;

datasets.name: d950223d
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    m.meetreeks_id,
    CONCAT(o.code, '_', r.code) AS object_meetreeks_code,
    m.tijdstempel_utc AS ts,
    m.waarde,
    TRY_CAST(r.eind_filter AS DOUBLE)        AS onderkant_filter,
    TRY_CAST(r.bovenkant_peilbuis AS DOUBLE) AS bovenkant_peilbuis
  FROM gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.meting m
  JOIN gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.meetreeks r
    ON m.meetreeks_id = r.id
  LEFT JOIN gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.object o
    ON o.id = r.object_id
  WHERE r.bronsysteem = 'Wiertsema'
),
calc AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    waarde - LAG(waarde) OVER (PARTITION BY meetreeks_id ORDER BY ts) AS delta_waarde,
    LAG(waarde) OVER (PARTITION BY meetreeks_id ORDER BY ts)          AS prev_waarde
  FROM base
),
flags AS (
  SELECT
    meetreeks_id,
    object_meetreeks_code,
    ts,

    CASE
      WHEN (bovenkant_peilbuis IS NOT NULL AND waarde > bovenkant_peilbuis)
        OR (onderkant_filter   IS NOT NULL AND waarde < onderkant_filter)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS v1_flag,

    CASE
      WHEN prev_waarde IS NOT NULL AND (delta_waarde > 0.3 OR delta_waarde < -0.05)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS v2_flag,

    CASE
      WHEN onderkant_filter IS NOT NULL
       AND waarde >= onderkant_filter
       AND waarde <= onderkant_filter + 0.20
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS v3_flag
  FROM calc
)
SELECT
  object_meetreeks_code,
  meetreeks_id,
  COUNT(*)     AS metingen,
  SUM(v1_flag) AS v1_out_of_bounds,
  SUM(v2_flag) AS v2_step_change,
  SUM(v3_flag) AS v3_droogstand,
  MAX(ts)      AS last_ts
FROM flags
GROUP BY object_meetreeks_code, meetreeks_id
ORDER BY (v1_out_of_bounds + v2_step_change + v3_droogstand) DESC, object_meetreeks_code

datasets.name: dcd6f99a
queryLines:
WITH wiertsema AS (
  SELECT m.meetreeks_id, m.tijdstempel_utc AS ts, m.waarde,
         CONCAT(o.code, '_', r.code) AS object_meetreeks_code
  FROM gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.meting m
  JOIN gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.meetreeks r ON r.id = m.meetreeks_id
  LEFT JOIN gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.object o ON o.id = r.object_id
  WHERE r.bronsysteem = 'Wiertsema'
    AND m.waarde IS NOT NULL
),
baseline AS (          -- gemiddelde over dag -14 t/m -2
  SELECT meetreeks_id, AVG(waarde) AS baseline_avg, COUNT(*) AS baseline_n
  FROM wiertsema
  WHERE ts >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 14)
    AND ts <  DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, 1)     -- t/m eind van dag -2
  GROUP BY meetreeks_id
),
recent AS (            -- gemiddelde over de laatste 24 uur
  SELECT meetreeks_id, AVG(waarde) AS recent_avg, COUNT(*) AS recent_n,
         MAX(ts) AS last_ts
  FROM wiertsema
  WHERE ts >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 24 HOURS
  GROUP BY meetreeks_id
)
SELECT
  w.object_meetreeks_code,
  b.meetreeks_id,
  ROUND(b.baseline_avg, 3) AS baseline_avg,
  ROUND(r.recent_avg,  3) AS recent_avg,
  ROUND(r.recent_avg - b.baseline_avg, 3) AS delta,   -- >0 stijging, <0 daling
  b.baseline_n,
  r.recent_n,
  r.last_ts
FROM baseline b
JOIN recent r ON r.meetreeks_id = b.meetreeks_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT meetreeks_id, object_meetreeks_code FROM wiertsema) w
  ON w.meetreeks_id = b.meetreeks_id
ORDER BY delta DESC

datasets.name: 9ed7255e
queryLines:
WITH wiertsema AS (
  SELECT m.meetreeks_id, m.tijdstempel_utc AS ts, m.waarde,
         CONCAT(o.code, '_', r.code) AS object_meetreeks_code
  FROM gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.meting m
  JOIN gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.meetreeks r ON r.id = m.meetreeks_id
  LEFT JOIN gold_prd.hl_grondwaterpeilmeting.object o ON o.id = r.object_id
  WHERE r.bronsysteem = 'Wiertsema'
    AND m.waarde IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (                       -- "normaal": mediaan, min en max over de hele reeks
  SELECT meetreeks_id,
         percentile(waarde, 0.5) AS mediaan,
         MIN(waarde) AS min_w,
         MAX(waarde) AS max_w,
         COUNT(*)    AS hist_n
  FROM wiertsema
  GROUP BY meetreeks_id
),
recent AS (                      -- huidige waarde: gemiddelde laatste 24 uur
  SELECT meetreeks_id,
         AVG(waarde) AS huidige_waarde,
         COUNT(*)    AS recent_n,
         MAX(ts)     AS last_ts
  FROM wiertsema
  WHERE ts >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 24 HOURS
  GROUP BY meetreeks_id
)
SELECT
  w.object_meetreeks_code,
  s.meetreeks_id,
  ROUND(r.huidige_waarde, 3) AS huidige_waarde,
  ROUND(s.mediaan, 3) AS mediaan,
  ROUND(s.min_w, 3)   AS min_normaal,
  ROUND(s.max_w, 3)   AS max_normaal,
  -- natheid-index: +100 = max (nat), 0 = mediaan, -100 = min (droog)
  ROUND(
    GREATEST(-100, LEAST(100,
      CASE
        WHEN r.huidige_waarde >= s.mediaan
          THEN  100.0 * (r.huidige_waarde - s.mediaan) / NULLIF(s.max_w - s.mediaan, 0)
        ELSE -100.0 * (s.mediaan - r.huidige_waarde) / NULLIF(s.mediaan - s.min_w, 0)
      END
    )), 1
  ) AS natheid_index,
  s.hist_n,
  r.recent_n,
  r.last_ts
FROM stats s
JOIN recent r ON r.meetreeks_id = s.meetreeks_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT meetreeks_id, object_meetreeks_code FROM wiertsema) w
  ON w.meetreeks_id = s.meetreeks_id
ORDER BY natheid_index DESC
